summary: Independent verification reproduced the isolated environment and both required commands successfully, and found no implementation scope violation or lock-content defect. The result is nevertheless FAIL because the implementation evidence is not mutually consistent: lock-diff.txt records a sha256_after value that matches neither the verified implementation blob nor the checked-out file.

regression_risks: The checked-out MASTER_PLAN.md and batches.json hashes are 81A22727C179E5A4628C84D7412210EAE32317B378B4051DA2B91FE7A2B1E183 and CBB7929A82453197BCA637F7D4470538DA909097B4A47C1BD6DB0A52406487D6, differing from the scheduler-supplied authoritative hashes. This pre-existed the implementation diff, is recorded only as provenance risk, and did not cause this FAIL or authorize plan edits.
The frozen closure was measured on CPython 3.13.5/Windows; compatibility on other interpreter/platform combinations was not part of this verification.

Stock pip freeze inspects the editable package before applying --exclude and fails on stale historical Git worktree metadata. The implementation records a temporary ignored-venv metadata workaround; future evidence generation should preserve an explicit, reproducible record of that step.
